fusions.name: Snag and Tear
fusions.desc: Barbed legs catch and rip an enemy for 8 damage, using up one of your afflictions on it, and leave it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Cast
fusions.desc: Casts 4 barbed knots of locusts in a spread, each one dealing 11 damage. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Reeled to the Cloud
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. For 4 seconds, an escort of locusts fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbs Hold, Mouths Feed
fusions.desc: When you strike an enemy, your attacks heal you for 12% of the damage they deal for 3 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
